summary: The PR addresses the issue of deleting an index_together when there is a unique_together on the same fields by filtering constraints based on their type. The changes are relevant and the approach seems reasonable.

issues.description: The code could benefit from additional comments explaining the logic, especially around filtering constraints by type.
The new test files and structure could follow the existing conventions of the Django test suite, such as placing the test within an appropriate test module rather than a standalone script.
